Name: Miracle Eye
Effect: The User's Psychic-Type Moves ignore Dark-Type Immunity. Target cannot Evade the User's Moves. This Pokémon's Accuracy cannot be Reduced by Move's, Items or Abilities (ie Sand Attack, Bright Powder, etc.). Whole Scene Duration
Description: The Pokémon opens up the third eye. Their sight transcends the barriers of flesh. No one goes undetected.
